name: 两个名字 · 学徒篇 VOL.5（中级）
desc: 2026 暑假特辑 SP6M《两个名字·学徒篇》中级档（学徒版）语法命门 12 题。本卷的看图命门（13–17）、传记阅读（18–20）、词梯、辨笔迹区依赖纸面主图与机关，未进题库。

m5.q: The swap spell lasts only ___ hour, not a day.
m5.why: hour 的 h 不发音，开口就是元音音素，所以用 an。

m5.q: Xi's pen ___ the truth, even when her mouth is joking.
m5.why: 频度副词 always 站在实义动词前面；主语 pen 是单数，动词用 tells。

m5.q: Look! Xi ___ Jin's hair by the window again.
m5.why: Look! 提示动作正在眼前发生，用现在进行时 is braiding。

m5.q: This time yesterday, the two girls ___ each other's names in the illusion.
m5.why: this time yesterday（昨天这个时候）是过去进行时的专用锚：主语复数，用 were using。

m5.q: Xi didn't leave ___ coins in the jar — not even one.
Nobody in the school writes as ___ as Xi.
m5.why: as…as 中间放原级；修饰动词 writes 要用副词 beautifully。

m5.q: Both of the notes on the wall ___ lies — read together, they tell the truth.
m5.why: both = 两个都，主语天生复数，现在时用 are。

m5.q: Jin decided ___ Xi's name to protect her.
m5.why: decide to do sth 是固定搭配。

m5.q: — Thank you for braiding my hair again.　— ___ I liked doing it.
m5.why: 对方在道谢，回 My pleasure（我的荣幸／不客气），后一句 I liked doing it 正好接上。

m5.q: Xi ___ Jin's name for an hour and gave it back when the spell ended.
m5.why: 从别人那里拿来用，方向朝里，用 borrow；过去式 borrowed。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: The words on the jar are in Jin's small letters.
Xi was naughty, but she fixed everything in the end.
Xi runned out of the study with the snacks.
The girls' hour in the illusion changed them both.
m5.why: run 是不规则动词，过去式是 ran——没有 runned 这个词。

m5.q: Mr Wolf noticed ___ in the crooked letters at once.
m5.why: 形容词修饰不定代词一律后置——something strange。
